capabilities: Move completed checkboxes to the bottom of their peer group
Preserve nested list structure while sorting
Configure sorting globally, per file via frontmatter, or per list via marker comments
Handle multiple lists in one file
problem: Obsidian leaves completed checkboxes in place, so finished tasks clutter the middle of task lists.
summary: Checkbox sorter that automatically moves completed checkboxes to the bottom of their list group when toggled, preserving nested list structure.
